combo_label: School Days × Cycling × The Wild West

entries.clue: Coloured top the race leader pulls on each morning
Bare metal hoop that a tyre is stretched onto
Little red disc that bounces headlights back at drivers
Small toothed wheel, or a lowly worker in a vast machine
Bag slung beside a rear rack for carrying the shopping home
Guided trip round a city, or the great July race in France
Swing-door drinking den with a piano and a card game in the corner
Looped rope a rider whirls overhead to catch a running calf
Group of young singers rehearsing for the carol service
Lidded table with an inkwell hole and carved initials
Cowboy's broad-brimmed felt hat, the maker's surname now the word for it
Horse chestnut threaded on string, swung in an autumn duel
